definitions.gloss: big stage; major occasion; the world stage
definitions.explanation: A large, important stage, and by extension a major event where much is at stake and many are watching: a final, the Olympics, a national election. Said of the occasion where someone gets a big chance or must perform under pressure.

examples.japanese: {大舞台|おおぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: To step onto the big stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大舞台|おおぶたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was nervous on my first big stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{大舞台|おおぶたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自己|じこ}ベスト→自己ベスト：06967_jikobesuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: She set a personal best on the big stage of the Olympics.

notes:
Usually read おおぶたい; だいぶたい is also heard. Common in sports and entertainment reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大舞台|おおぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to appear on the big stage
- {大舞台|おおぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to rise to the big occasion
- {大舞台|おおぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: to perform at a major event
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大舞台|おおぶたい}: the world stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}→晴れ舞台：14925_harebutai⟧: one's big moment — a proud, celebratory occasion
- ⟦{表舞台|おもてぶたい}→表舞台：20605_omotebutai⟧: the public stage — being in public view at all, not one event
